intro_say: Trump's day, in five quotes. Let's go!
outro_say: Love it or hate it, every speech and post from today is linked in the caption. Follow for tomorrow's five!

quotes.quote: Pretend that I'm on the ballot. Because when I'm on the ballot, for whatever reason, 49.2% more people show up.
quotes.quote_say: Pretend that I'm on the ballot. Because when I'm on the ballot, for whatever reason, forty-nine point two percent more people show up.

quotes.quote: I always wait for people to start leaving, but they never leave.
quotes.intro_say: On how long his speeches run.
quotes.said_before_note: He made the same boast at 2024 rallies

quotes.quote: Paid protester. They pop up every once in a while. Don't worry about it.
quotes.intro_say: On a protester in the crowd.

quotes.quote: They don't know what the hell they're doing, economists.
quotes.intro_say: On economists, after new growth numbers.

quotes.quote: They are fake news, you're fake news, do you understand that?
quotes.intro_say: And on news coverage of crowd sizes.
